steps.title: How does a game of Ludo start?

items.title: Pick your colour
items.text: Yellow, green, pink or cyan: the other three colours are played by bots.

items.title: Roll to see who starts
items.text: The highest number starts. In case of a tie, only the tied players roll again until there is a single winner.

items.title: Aim for a six
items.text: Each player rolls the die up to three times in a row, until one of them gets a six.

items.title: Off you go!
items.text: The game is on. Bring your pawns out and get all four of them home. Good luck!

config.metaDescription: Choose the number of players and pawns, the die faces and the colours to play Ludo at your own pace. Your settings stay on this device.
config.lead: Fewer players, fewer pawns, fewer low numbers on the die: the game goes faster. Your choices are saved on this device and apply to your next game.

classic.title: Classic
classic.text: 4 players, 4 pawns, every face of the die.

quick.title: Quick
quick.text: 3 players, 2 pawns, the die from 3 to 6.

express.title: Express
express.text: 2 players, 1 pawn, the die from 4 to 6.

players.title: Players
players.text: How many players around the board? You play against the bots. With two, you sit face to face.

dice.title: Die faces
dice.text: Click a face to turn it on or off. The die only lands on the faces that are on.
dice.sixWarning: The 6 always stays on: it is what brings pawns out.
dice.lenient: Without the low numbers, a pawn enters the home column as soon as the roll is big enough, no exact number needed.

pawns.title: Pawns per player
pawns.text: The first to bring all their pawns home wins. With a single pawn, a game takes a few minutes.

rhythm.title: Pace and rules
rhythm.text: To go even faster, or to play the way you are used to.

speed.label: Bot speed
speed.text: How long each bot takes to play.

threeTries.label: 3 tries to bring out the first pawn
threeTries.text: Until someone is out, each player rolls up to 3 times.

reducedMotion.label: Reduced animations
reducedMotion.text: Pawns move without hopping, the die does not tumble.

share.title: Save and share
share.text: Keep your settings in a file, or send the code to a friend so they can play with the same ones.

summary.title: Your game
